title: Death Replay
description: if you die in minecraft then by clicking the added button then you can see how you died (best for dying in traps)
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/krV40UkhFFM" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe> Death Replay  
Ever died and had no idea what hit you? Death Replay records the last ~15 seconds before every death and lets you watch it back from your own eyes.  
When you die, a gold ▶ Death Replay button appears under the respawn options. Click it and the camera flies back along the exact path you walked — every step, every hit — so you can finally see what got you.  
Features  

Instant replay on death — one button, right on the death screen.  
True first-person playback — the camera retraces your real movement and view, smoothly interpolated.  
Damage timeline — every hit you took is marked on the scrubber: attacks, falls, explosions, fire, lava, drowning, the void, and more.  
Full transport controls — play, pause, rewind, step, scrub, and 0.25×–2× speed.
